limitations: This successor records the seven named local database-process recovery scenarios after explicit export raw-stream ownership was added, at the exact observed source, engine, driver, migration and durability settings. Separate local real-I/O fault-injection tests establish buffered finalization, descriptor reuse, control precedence and retained-resource recovery.

The harness materializes a small synthetic fixture across 20 public tables. Representative workload cost and production recovery objectives retain their own observations.

The signed v0.3.2 release, historical V005/V007 hosted receipts and earlier native recovery/resource-cleanup receipts retain their original evidence. Accountable Engineering, Security, Operations, Scientific, Quality and Regulatory acceptance remains with the named environment owners.
Private build, connection, log and resource coordinates remain with the local execution owner; the normalized source and observation digests preserve the evidence boundary.
